where: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11, each season loaded from the local cache into its own schema
question: Is the set of lineups referenced by game_event rows the same as the set referenced by lineup_stint rows? Tier B moves three queries from the first to the second.
query: select (select count(*) from lineup l where exists (select 1 from game_event e where e.season_code = $1 and l.lineup_id in (e.home_lineup_id, e.away_lineup_id))) as by_event, (select count(*) from lineup l where exists (select 1 from lineup_stint s where s.season_code = $1 and l.lineup_id in (s.home_lineup_id, s.away_lineup_id))) as by_stint, (select count(*) from lineup) as all_lineups, (select count(*) from lineup_stint s where not exists (select 1 from game_event e where e.season_code = s.season_code and e.gamecode = s.gamecode and e.stint_index = s.stint_index)) as stints_without_events
what_this_does_not_establish: Equality on a season where a stint has no events. None exists in either season; the gate's unattached_events and event_stint_mismatches invariants are what make the two questions equivalent by construction rather than by coincidence.
